summary: Training video 8.2 (Warranties - Wrong Device, Seller and KAM audience, 02:43). The narrator walks through the wrong-device warranty claim in the Revibe seller portal and on the workflow slide: the customer's claim is raised on Revibe, the seller checks the device received, then marks the claim Valid (send the right device if in stock, otherwise refund) or Invalid (written reason plus proof, Revibe checks it, the Lab decides). All 27 frames in the pack were opened. Screens are the workflow overview slide, the R - Seller Warranties claims list, the claim detail panel with Mark valid/Mark invalid, the availability and IMEI dialogs, a ship-back tracking section, a claim statuses view, the invalid-proof dialog, and the recap.
